capabilities: Move checked items below unchecked ones within each task group
Sort automatically when a checkbox is clicked in Reading View
Sort the current note on demand via a command in Source, Live Preview, or Reading View
Keep nested sub-tasks grouped with their parents while sorting at every level
Treat only [x] as done so custom statuses stay with the not-done items
extras: Sorting in edit modes (Source/Live Preview) only happens through the manual command, not automatically; automatic sorting works only in Reading View.
problem: Obsidian leaves completed checklist items where they are, so remaining work gets buried among finished tasks.
summary: Task-list helper that moves checked checklist items to the bottom of their task group, sorting on checkbox click or via a command.
